name: black-friday-ads-and-sales-report
description: Use for "how did our Black Friday go", "Black Friday sales report", "BFCM post-mortem", "did our Black Friday ads make money after returns", "compare this Black Friday to last year", or "what do we change for next year's sale" — even when the user never says "post-mortem". Use after a Black Friday, Cyber Monday, Prime Day or store sale, when the decision is what to keep and change next time. Google Ads, Facebook Ads, TikTok Ads and Shopify.
